acceptanceCriteria: A Ruby/RSpec row under --mutate yields either per-mutant killed/survived verdicts with retained receipts, or a typed unsupported witness with a reason; never silent absence; covered by tests and the spec.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1321. `corvint prove --mutate` collects hunk spans only for `*.go`/`*.py`, requires `_test.go` mutation groups and dispatches Python on `.py`, so a row citing an RSpec example over a changed `.rb` file gets no mutation witness and callers cannot tell not-attempted from no-mutants. Behavior-falsification perturbs the environment, clones per attempt and keeps no receipts for `survived`, so it is not a substitute. Expected: either hunk-confined .rb mutants run through a declared runner (pinned container command) with killed/survived per mutant and a retained receipt per run, or an explicit `unsupported` mutation witness with a reason for Ruby rows.
title: prove --mutate: Ruby/RSpec rows get no mutation witness; add line-level .rb mutation or an explicit unsupported witness
